Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: individual original Petal character illustration, transparent square PNG.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference ONLY, our original Petal hello illustration. Create the new subject below, preserving the simple dot-face, rounded graphic clothing, adult proportions, friendly restrained expressions, rose/plum palette and clean flat silhouettes. Do NOT redraw the reference pose.
Flat 2D editorial vector-like art made of large uniform solid fills, with VERY few internal lines. No lighting, gradients, grain, 3D shading, detailed realistic face, fine hair strands, black outlines or opaque exterior keyline. Exact palette anchors Rose #B83D70, Blush #FCE8EF, Soft white #FFF7FA, White #FFFFFF, Deep plum #33252D, Muted plum #745D69; natural warm skin tones are allowed. Each illustration has one adult and their indicated single prop. Center the whole figure/prop together, full body/feet/hands visible with at least 12 percent transparent padding on EVERY edge. No ground plane, backdrop shapes, scenery, card, text, letters, logos, marks, watermark or confetti. Genuine transparent alpha with clean antialiased silhouette edges. Gentle adult app art, never a reward, punishment, health/protection state, medical instruction or clinical diagram.
Subject: An adult woman with warm olive skin and rounded shoulder-length deep-plum wavy hair, blush blouse, deep-plum relaxed trousers and soft-white shoes. Standing in an easy three-quarter posture, holding an open rose-and-white book at chest height with both hands, looking attentively toward the blank pages. Simple dot eyes and calm slightly smiling mouth. No text on the book. Full figure and feet within the canvas, distinct pose from the reference.
